# Heading

Section and page titles in Inter 600, sizes from the type scale.

`KenosUI.Heading` · Typography

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Heading />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Heading"></x-import>
```

## Props (HeadingProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "2xl" \| "3xl" \| "4xl" \| "5xl" \| "6xl"` | Default "xl". 4xl=h1, 3xl=h2, 2xl=h3, xl=h4, lg=h5, md=h6 (tag follows the size unless `as`). |
| `as` | `"h1" \| "h2" \| "h3" \| "h4" \| "h5" \| "h6" \| "p" \| "span" \| "div"` |  |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>._
